column1: # Arms of the publication simulation set. One row per arm, one column per config
# key, so this file IS the published ARMS.tsv and can be diffed mechanically
# against any run's stage2_params.txt.
# An ARM is an analysis/parameter cell run across every category; a CATEGORY is a
# genetic model run in every arm (helpers/publication_categories.tsv). The four
# arms here differ in NOTHING except how the causal loci are chosen -- same
# floors, same multipliers, same trait counts, same region, same seeds. That is
# the point, and it is also why `require_gtex_partner` must reach the path:
# without it arms 1 and 2 write byte-identical filenames.
#   causal_maf001_paired     the closest to every previous round-3 arm: a uniform
#                            draw from the MAF >= 0.001 pool, intersected with the
#                            GTEx panel so every GWAS locus has a partner.
#   causal_maf001_unpaired   the same draw WITHOUT the intersection. Newly
#                            expressible: the pairing used to be derived from the
#                            sampling scheme.
#   causal_power_n200000     loci weighted by their probability of detection in a
#                            200,000-person GWAS -- "which loci would a large
#                            study report?" -- without changing the simulated
#                            8,000-person GWAS.
#   causal_power_n8000       the same weighting at this run's own GWAS size.
# The two power arms drop the MAF floor (causal_min_maf 0): the detection-power
# weight is already a preference over frequency and effect size jointly, so a
# floor on top would confound the two. NOTE that this makes the power arms'
# eligible pool a superset of the uniform arms', which is why they are read as a
# different question, not as a stricter version of the same one.
# sampling_gwas_n is carried on the uniform arms too, at its RESOLVED value
# (gwas_size, 8000). It has no effect there -- nothing computes a power weight
# under a uniform draw -- but the Snakefile defaults it to gwas_size and
# params_record hashes it into stage2_uid, so recording it keeps this file
# column-for-column comparable with every run's params record.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
arm
causal_maf001_paired
column23: uniform draw from the MAF>=0.001 pool; causal loci REQUIRED to segregate in both panels

column1: causal_maf001_unpaired
column23: uniform draw from the MAF>=0.001 pool; causal loci NOT required in both panels

column1: causal_power_n200000
column23: power-weighted draw (n=200000, no plateau), no MAF floor; not required in both panels

column1: causal_power_n8000
column23: power-weighted draw (n=8000, no plateau), no MAF floor; not required in both panels
